call_points.text: India capex in FY26 was approximately ₹800 crores and is expected to remain similar in FY27.
Overall new order wins in India during FY26 stood at ₹1,579 crores, excluding Bajaj Auto.
Standalone EBITDA margin for FY26 was 12.6%, impacted by non-value add commodity cost increases.
AURIC Bidkin alloy wheel plant capacity is 48 lakh wheel sets per annum.
European operations booked orders worth €15.80 million in FY26.
Maharashtra Package Scheme of Incentives 2019 incentive was enhanced from ₹600 crores to ₹858 crores.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and shipping disruptions have caused volatility in energy and raw material costs.
Maxwell achieved a record turnover of ₹162 crores in FY26 compared to ₹70 crores in FY25.

timeline.summary: Endurance Technologies Limited scheduled an analysts/institutional investor meet on 15th May 2026 at 11:00 AM IST to discuss Q4FY26 audited financial results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,085.95 Cr (+37.9% YoY), net profit ₹276.45 Cr (+12.8% YoY).
Endurance Technologies announced that the Joint Commissioner (ST), Appeals set aside a ₹98.28 lakh tax demand order for FY20-21.
Endurance Tech received fresh order dropping ₹12.07 Cr of ₹12.39 Cr tax demand for FY22, confirming ₹32.49 lakh.
Endurance Technologies reported FY26 consolidated total income of ₹14,720 Cr (+26.1% YoY) and PAT of ₹952 Cr (+13.8% YoY).
Endurance Technologies Limited sought shareholder approval via remote e-voting for re-appointing Mr. Anant Talaulicar (DIN: 00031051) as Independent Director for five years from 12th July 2026.
Endurance Technologies Limited’s shareholders approved Mr. Anant Talaulicar’s (DIN: 00031051) re-appointment as Independent Director for five years via postal ballot.

On 14 August 2026 Endurance's Q1FY27 call reported consolidated revenue up 29.6% to ₹4,348 Cr but PAT up only 8% to ₹244.52 Cr as commodity pass-through lifted the raw-material share to 68.4% of standalone income.
Endurance Technologies Limited scheduled a conference call for analysts and investors on 4th November 2026 at 11:00 a.m. (IST) to discuss unaudited Q2FY27 financial results.
